neighbours.label: clause boundaries in machine-translated industrial product copy (' This', ', greatly', ' the', after a run of selling points)
fire: This crusher has stable performance, low noise, long working life, greatly reducing the maintenance cost. This series is widely used in building materials.
Our factory has rich experience, the price is reasonable, welcome friends at home and abroad to order. This model valve is suitable for petroleum.
The cutting tool adopts imported alloy, high precision, greatly improving production efficiency. The product is widely used in aerospace.
The sieve has simple structure, convenient installation, the output is high. This equipment can greatly save labor.
The bearing surface treatment is advanced, the wear resistance is strong, in order to meet customer demand. This kind of bearing sell well all over the country.
The conveyor belt adopts high strength material, smooth operation, which can greatly reduce energy consumption.
Our company adheres to quality first, the service is considerate, customers are satisfied. This production line has passed ISO certification.
The laser welder is easy to operate, the weld seam is beautiful, greatly shortening the processing cycle. This machine enjoys high reputation.
quiet: This crusher was bought second-hand in 2009 and has been noisy ever since. Its owner wants to replace it before winter.
Our factory closed last year, and the workers were sad to go. This valve was one of the last things we made.
The cutting tool broke on Tuesday, and the foreman sent it back. The supplier has not replied yet.
The sieve sat in the shed for years until my uncle found it. He sold it to a neighbour.
The bearing failed during the test, so the engineers took it apart. They found a crack in the outer ring.
The conveyor belt jammed twice this morning, and we had to call the mechanic.
Our company picnic was rained out, so people stayed home. The production line kept running as usual.
The laser welder in our lab is shared by three groups. Mine uses it on Fridays.

notes: Card: ' the', ' This', ' greatly', ' improving' in Chinglish tool and mill copy, and '，', '！', '。' in Chinese. Probe: 'widely used in metallurgy, greatly saving' 0.918; 'This series pump' 0.551, 0.527; ordinary mill sentence 0.051; family car 0.040; Chinese copy only 0.181, 0.277. Near misses keep the machines and drop the sales register.
